units.source_text: 忠左卫门拿起手边的烟袋，装上烟，文静地吟味着烟香。

en.t: Chuzaemon picked up the pipe at his side, filled it with tobacco, and quietly savored the fragrance of the smoke.

units.source_text: 早春的下午是那么明朗静寂，吐出来的一缕青烟袅袅上升，逐渐消失了。

en.t: The early spring afternoon was so bright and still; a wisp of bluish smoke he had breathed out rose softly and gradually vanished.
